title: Network Delay Time
keyIdea: Single-source shortest paths with non-negative weights → Dijkstra from k. The time for everyone to receive the signal is the largest shortest distance; if any node is unreachable, −1.

approaches.name: Dijkstra with a min-heap
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). dist[k] = 0; pop {d, u}, skip stale entries, relax u's edges and push improvements; answer max(dist) or −1.
approaches.why: Each edge can push once; heap operations are O(log E) = O(log V).

quiz.q: Why is a node final when it comes off the heap with the smallest time?
options: Weights are non-negative, so any other route is at least as slow
The heap is sorted by node number
It is an old heap entry; u was already reached faster
The maximum of all shortest times, or −1 if a node is unreachable
